_comment: Recorded answers for test_period_fetch.py part 7 (L-443, Pluto's year). Written 2026-10-28 with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, built on orrery b2fcc1bb50d6bbf30fc91ac58de474483a5c7c02. Every answer is JPL's own, recorded live; none is constructed. Record 9 asked as a major body (id_type None) is 'Pluto Barycenter (9)'. The same run's first attempt asked 9 as a small body and JPL answered for the asteroid 9 Metis (a period of 1,346.6 days); that answer is not kept here, and the test plants that fault and finds no answer for it. The test treats a query with no answer here as JPL not reached.
when_note: The time the test passes as 'now'. fetch_osculating_elements adds 69 seconds (UTC to TDB) and writes it to the minute, which gives the epoch '2026-10-28 20:36'.
